name: Runners
summary:
# Welcome To Runners !! 🟨🎮️

Runners is just a gtag fangame with locomotion and maps/arcades/customizing and even just hanging out in general.
Play with your friends. Play with random strangers, or even make them as your buddy!

# The game is really on alpha so expect glitches or bugs.
